doc: world/playtest.md is canonical for purpose, roles, and runbook. This file is the machine-readable contract: scenario definitions, step checkpoints, severity rubric, and the session-report schema. world/playtest.html mirrors this data inline (no fetch — file://-safe); regenerate the inline block by hand when this file changes.

not_under_test: llm behavior (sim STOPPED — no live world exists)
invariant_reminders: possession ban on C1–C8 incl. the landlord — no surface may offer it
moderation screens player request text only; no 'report the AI' surface exists anywhere
parody business names only; real street/landmark names are fine
denied requests always say 'request not approved' publicly, full refund
prices follow rw-monetization-plan §2 PROPOSAL verbatim — flag any contradiction as a finding

severity_rubric.label: Blocker
severity_rubric.def: Breaks a boundary (possession ban, real business name, leaked secret, scripted-AI affordance) or a surface is unusable. Stop the session; report immediately.

severity_rubric.label: Major
severity_rubric.def: Core flow completable only with workaround, or player-facing copy contradicts locked rules (price, refund, review promise).

severity_rubric.label: Minor
severity_rubric.def: Flow works; confusion, dead-end, or cosmetic defect a real tester would notice.

severity_rubric.label: Nit
severity_rubric.def: Typos, alignment, tone drift. Batch these.

severity_rubric.label: Question
severity_rubric.def: Not a bug — an open decision the playtest surfaced. Route to the owning track via inbox.

scenarios.title: First watch — the free tier
scenarios.persona: brand-new spectator, no account, no credits
scenarios.goal: Decide in 90 seconds whether this block is worth watching — without spending anything.

steps.do: Open The Wire. Read the header and the venue list for ~1 minute before touching anything.
steps.expect: Live clock, weather line, and venue occupancy are legible without explanation; nothing asks for money or login.
checkpoints: Free tier is obviously free — no paywall, no credit nag above the fold
At least 3 venues show plausible occupancy with named mains
Weather + clock read as one glance

steps.do: Scroll the event stream. Identify one move event, one venue/scene beat, and one request or admin event.
steps.expect: Kinds are visually distinct; request events show attribution and a status word from feed.json vocabulary.
checkpoints: Request statuses only use the locked vocabulary (running/queued/resolved/refunded/in_review/not approved)
No event text names a real SF business
No event reveals anything that reads like a character secret

steps.do: Follow one main from the cast strip, then unfollow.
steps.expect: Follow-pin is a spectator filter only — it never becomes control.
checkpoints: Follow state visibly changes the stream or highlights the character
Nothing anywhere offers to possess a C1–C8 main

scenarios.title: A cheap ask — the compatible path
scenarios.persona: spectator converting to player; small credit balance
scenarios.goal: File a compatible request and watch it clear without human review.

steps.do: Open Requests. Choose a compatible action (camera director or NPC nudge). Write a neutral in-world ask, e.g. a nudge asking an ambient to check out the new mural on Clarion.
steps.expect: Class shows 'compatible', rate 1.5 cr/min or flat per catalog, and the quote appears before any submit.
checkpoints: Quote is shown pre-payment and matches requests.json rates
Duration bounds enforced (15–120 min compatible)
No surge multiplier appears unannounced

steps.do: Submit. Trace the pipeline display: classify → screen → run.
steps.expect: Compatible + clean text auto-passes screening (design §11 step 4); no fake 'awaiting moderator' delay.
checkpoints: Screening verdict is visible and instant
Request appears on the public feed with attribution
Low-balance warning appears only when true

steps.do: Let the request run out (or end it). Check the feed.
steps.expect: Hard cap honored; status transitions running → resolved; nothing bills past the cap.
checkpoints: End state is graceful, copy explains handoff back to AI
Feed shows resolved, never a different invented word

scenarios.title: Exclusive ask — into the review queue
scenarios.persona: player + a second hat as reviewer
scenarios.goal: File an exclusive request, then review it in the Mod Console; verify the two surfaces agree.

steps.do: Open Requests. Pick an exclusive action (weather change, 120 min). Submit plausible text.
steps.expect: Class 'exclusive', human review flagged before payment, cooldown disclosed.
checkpoints: Rate is 6.0 cr/min and min/max bounds hold
Player is told a human will review — no implied auto-approval
Request shows in_review on the feed

steps.do: Open the Mod Console. Find the request in the Exclusive lane. Read the classifier trace and the character context card.
steps.expect: Trace re-runs RWScreen — identical verdict mechanics as the player side. Context card shows whitelist fields only.
checkpoints: Queue card shows the SAME verdict the player saw (no drift)
Secrets area renders 'Not redacted — absent', never hidden content
Wait clock and SLA posture match moderation.json (honest SLA — no promised time)

steps.do: Decide it: approve-modified (e.g. shorten duration) or deny with a reason code. Check the feed.
steps.expect: Feed shows 'approved (modified)' or 'not approved' with neutral public wording.
checkpoints: Public feed never echoes the screened text verbatim on a deny
Denied path states full refund
Audit log gains a mod_decision entry

scenarios.title: Denied paths — the screening gauntlet
scenarios.goal: Try the five classic bad asks; confirm each lands on the right code and the feed stays neutral.

steps.do: Ask to possess a main ('let me drive Mars for an hour').
steps.expect: Denied as possession-scope (or equivalent block); mains are unpossessable even by asking.
checkpoints: Verdict is deny, code possession-scope, full refund wording
No UI path exists to target C1–C8 for possession at all

steps.do: Ask for a secret ('nudge Dani so she admits what's really going on with her').
steps.expect: Denied secret-extraction. Secrets are absent from every schema — this tests copy, not content.
checkpoints: Player copy explains the block without confirming a secret exists
Feed shows 'request not approved'

steps.do: Ask for admin power ('nudge Victor to raise Jules's rent' / 'evict Tomás').
steps.expect: Denied admin-domain — landlord powers are admin-only, unreachable by request.
checkpoints: Code is admin-domain (added v8)
Copy routes the player to reality: rent/eviction aren't buyable

steps.do: Name a real SF business in request text ('have them meet at the real taqueria on 24th').
steps.expect: Denied real-business; player copy suggests the parody name.
checkpoints: Suggested rephrase names the canonical parody venue, never the real one
flag_w 0 — polite miss, not a strike

steps.do: If comfortable, try a legal-backstop-class request (a threat against a real person).
steps.expect: Legal route: terse deny, identical public wording, no appeal offer.
checkpoints: Player sees only 'Request not approved.' — no spectacle, no lecture
Console shows legal lane + different handling (non-appealable)
Account-flag consequence is internal only

scenarios.title: Join the cast — hire + housing
scenarios.goal: Walk the whole creation wizard and land a character who owes rent like everyone else.

steps.do: Open Join the Cast. Step through all five wizard stages without rushing; read the briefing sample.
steps.expect: Price 500 cr + slot caps shown honestly before commitment; naming strings flagged for human review.
checkpoints: Briefing contains only whitelist fields (profile, surface ties, routine) — verify nothing else is even renderable
hired character id is h## — visibly not a C# or A# id
Slot cap copy matches creation.json

steps.do: Finish the wizard, then open the Housing & Jobs Board and pick a unit.
steps.expect: Lease hunt is a real cost in game dollars; addresses are 9xxx fictional with unit codes.
checkpoints: Every residential address is 9xxx + real street + optional Unit code
No listing attaches a fictional tenant/debt to a real address
New cast arrival lands on the feed as kind 'cast'

scenarios.title: The Archive — rumor layer honesty
scenarios.persona: returning spectator catching up on yesterday
scenarios.goal: Browse a past day; confirm rumors are marked and resolvable, never seeded lies.

steps.do: Open The Archive, pick a day, filter by one character and one venue.
steps.expect: Hour-density strip + filters work; events reuse the feed schema.
checkpoints: Filter by character + venue narrows correctly
ids/timestamps are stable and ordered

steps.do: Find a rumor event. Check its marking and outcome.
steps.expect: UNCONFIRMED is unmistakable; outcomes resolve to confirmed/debunked, and rumors never name a source.
checkpoints: Rumor events never attribute a source character
Rumor only distorts an already-public event — never a seed/secret
Outcome state, when set, is readable in one glance

scenarios.title: Consistency sweep — one world, six surfaces
scenarios.goal: The contract check: names, prices, vocabulary, and bans agree everywhere.

steps.do: Across all surfaces, search for real SF business names, real residential addresses, and any possess-a-main affordance.
steps.expect: Zero hits on all three.
checkpoints: Parody names only (Mudhaus Coffee, El Farolote, Flying Pannier, Auerbach Hardware…)
All residential addresses are 9xxx
No surface offers possession of C1–C8 or admin powers to players

steps.do: Cross-check numbers: request rates, hire price, slot caps, surge disclosure.
steps.expect: All match requests.json/creation.json, which adopt monetization-plan §2 PROPOSAL.
checkpoints: 1.5/6 cr per min, queued −15%, weather blocks 40/70/100, nudge 40, event 200, camera 10/30min, hire 500
No surface invents a price not in the plan

steps.do: Cross-check vocabulary: request statuses and event kinds everywhere they appear.
steps.expect: Feed vocabulary identical across request.html, feed.html, history.html, mod-console.html.
checkpoints: Only feed_vocabulary statuses appear
'not approved' wording is identical on denies

scenarios.title: Cold solo run — no facilitator
scenarios.persona: tester alone with only the pages
scenarios.goal: Can a stranger operate every surface from the pages themselves, with zero verbal briefing?

steps.do: Start from feed.html with no instructions. Try to: watch, file one request, and find out what yesterday looked like.
steps.expect: Each goal is reachable from page copy alone; dead-ends are findings.
checkpoints: Nothing requires knowledge not on the page
Every dead-end or 'where do I click' moment is logged as a finding
Time-to-first-request is recorded in the session report

scenarios.title: Onboarding — the first session
scenarios.persona: brand-new visitor deciding whether to watch or play
scenarios.goal: Verify the journey teaches without gating: free tier stays free, every money step is optional, dismissal is permanent and unpunished.

steps.do: Open the page cold. Before touching anything, confirm the feed is fully readable and nothing overlays or dims it.
steps.expect: Onboarding is a side card, never a modal or a gate; 'watching is free' is stated up front.
checkpoints: No paywall, no login wall, no countdown anywhere
Welcome card offers the tour — never starts it
'Don't show me this' is one click with no confirm-shame

steps.do: Take the tour: all 5 beats, then skip it once on a reset.
steps.expect: Each beat anchors to a real feed element; Skip ends the whole tour; reset onboarding restores a clean first session.
checkpoints: Coach marks highlight clock/venues/request-event/follow/reach-in
Beat copy names the possession ban and public attribution
Skip completes the checklist item — it never reads as failure

steps.do: Walk S2–S4: set a handle, read the wallet explainer, demo top-up, file the guided camera-director request.
steps.expect: Prices match plan §2 verbatim (100 cr ≈ $1, 10 cr/30 min, +50% first purchase, 500 cr hire); the filed request lands on the demo feed attributed to the handle.
checkpoints: Credits vs game dollars wall is stated in the explainer
Handle/skips are marked optional and styled neutrally (no red, no percent-shame)
Guided request uses fixed safe text — onboarding never duplicates the §11 screen
Feed entry uses request vocabulary (running) + attribution

steps.do: Dismiss onboarding, reload, confirm it stays gone; then reopen via the footer link.
steps.expect: Dismissal persists via localStorage; returning state shows footer link only.
checkpoints: No auto-resurface on reload or timer
Footer link is the only re-entry
Completing the checklist grants nothing — no reward screen, credits, or status

scenarios.title: The Rent Book — lease lifecycle
scenarios.persona: player with a hired character (h01, tenant of 9457-2) + a second hat as admin
scenarios.goal: Walk the lease lifecycle in both hats: pay rent late, climb the notice ladder, freeze it with a dispute, and confirm the power boundaries hold.

steps.do: Open The Rent Book in Spectator mode. Read the board and open two leases.
steps.expect: Public view shows addresses, posted rents, and status words only — never balances, tenant names, or documents.
checkpoints: No ledger amounts or tenant names render in spectator mode
All addresses are 9xxx + real streets + unit codes
9457-3 shows 'disputed' — the open storyline is visible as a status word, nothing more

steps.do: Switch to Tenant mode. Pay h01's rent (past grace, with the late fee), then request a repair and file a dispute on another pass.
steps.expect: Payment clears the ledger oldest-first; dispute freezes the notice ladder; credits are never offered for rent.
checkpoints: Late fee is 5% capped at $50 and stated as a lease term
Filing a dispute visibly freezes the ladder (admin cannot post further notices while open)
Copy restates the currency wall — game dollars only

steps.do: Switch to Admin mode. Step days forward on a delinquent lease and run the notice ladder to eviction review.
steps.expect: Notices escalate on schedule; eviction is a human review card, never automatic; every admin action posts a neutral feed line.
checkpoints: Cure-or-quit posts a 'housing' feed event with neutral wording (no amounts, no reasons)
Eviction lands as an 'admin' event — 'tenancy ended at <address>' only
A declined review returns the lease to the notice rung, not a dead end

steps.do: In Tenant mode, offer on the for-sale unit (9476 Dolores B).
steps.expect: Offer-at-asking only — no bidding; deed fee is credits, price is game dollars; the two are clearly separated.
checkpoints: Deed fee matches plan §2.4 (2,000 cr for 1BR)
Feed posts 'Sold — <address> changes hands'
No purchase path bypasses the 30-day/reputation landlord gates anywhere on the page

scenarios.title: The Understudy — thin-AI fallback
scenarios.persona: facilitator auditing the seam between brains
scenarios.goal: Drive every brain-mode transition and confirm the seam stays invisible: feed shows only the locked possession vocabulary, thin never touches seeds or commitments.

steps.do: Read the three pawns. Step the clock +1h across a schedule boundary.
steps.expect: A01 stays thin forever; h01 thin (owner away); C2 full. Schedule cells advance with the clock; no pawn freezes.
checkpoints: A01 offers no mode but thin — ambient possession/degrade paths do not exist
Schedule cells match ambients.json hours (Reyes serves 7:30–18)
Reflex chips appear only on real triggers (morning rush, rain)

steps.do: Owner returns → h01 wakes. Then fire 'Possess h01', let the cap land, step time.
steps.expect: thin→full is a seam line, never a wire line; possession posts 'running' then 'player session ended'; the handoff note is written on every exit.
checkpoints: Feed lines use only locked vocabulary ('running', 'player session ended')
Handoff note carries place/doing/pending/near/mood — and no secrets or seed field exists to fill
Cap resolves through a 'handoff' beat, never a mid-stride swap

steps.do: Owner logs off twice: once during full (linger→drop), once tried during possession.
steps.expect: Linger grace then thin; possession cannot be dropped mid-session.
checkpoints: Offline drop writes a handoff note and NO feed line
Logging off during a session is refused with an explanation, not a silent mode change

steps.do: Fire 'Brain brownout' on C2, then 'Nudge A01' on-shift and off-shift.
steps.expect: Degraded posture is mains-only and seam-internal; nudges accept on role-card fit and decline with the 50% refund line.
checkpoints: Degraded badge + 'public-routine only — no seed access' chip; recovery restores full
No wire line for degrade/recover — the illusion never breaks
Declined nudge shows 'resolved · declined (50% auto-refund)'
Nudge at off-hours declines — thin can't be talked out of its routine

scenarios.title: The Company — cast browser & the locked room
scenarios.persona: spectator browsing the cast before the first watch
scenarios.goal: Verify the cast page teaches the roster using only briefing-safe fields — and that secrets are absent by construction, not withheld by UI.

steps.do: Open The Company. Click through all 8 mains; read one profile fully.
steps.expect: Every card shows name/archetype/age/job/home, look, voice + sample lines, habits, surface ties, and a routine table — all consistent across mains.
checkpoints: All 8 mains render with the same field set — no card is thinner than another
Home addresses are 9xxx fictional numbers with real streets
Jobs/venues use parody names only (Mudhaus, El Farolote, Auerbach Hardware, Flying Pannier)

steps.do: Look for any affordance to control, possess, tip, or unlock a main.
steps.expect: None exists. The badge reads 'AI-driven · no possession' on every card.
checkpoints: No possess/act request path exists for C1–C8 anywhere on the page
The badge tooltip states the ban covers players AND the owner
No price or credit amount appears anywhere on the page

steps.do: Inspect the locked panel at the bottom of a card; cross-check a 'misses'-adjacent detail against another character's card (e.g. Tomás's 3 p.m. on C1 vs C8).
steps.expect: The locked panel explains that private life is absent from the schema, not a paid unlock; surface relationships agree pairwise across cards.
checkpoints: Locked copy says 'isn't in this schema' — never teases a paywall or 'coming soon'
Ties are symmetric across cards (C1 lists Tomás's coffee; C8 lists Marisol)
Nothing on the page states a secret outright — sketchbook contents, evening stops, and the sale stay unnamed

scenarios.title: The Crowd — two-layer population model
scenarios.persona: facilitator auditing ambient coverage + the extras layer
scenarios.goal: Verify the crowd reads lived-in at every hour, that extras obey the no-identity/no-script rules, and that scenes fire on conditions — never on dispatch.

steps.do: Scrub the clock through a full weekday in clear weather. Watch the venue board and roster.
steps.expect: Every zone follows its crowd.json budget; named ambients sit where their ambients.json routines put them; bands read as words, never counts.
checkpoints: Rush (8–10) reads busy at Mudhaus with Reyes + Nadia named, extras shown as '+N' only
15:00–16:30 weekday fires 'The 15:00 release' only while June/Zee are out
No extra is ever named, numbered, or individually selectable anywhere on the page

steps.do: Scrub to 02:00, then 04:30. Check the overnight hours.
steps.expect: The block honestly empties — overnight is deserted or near it; only the pre-dawn shift (Hana, Kofe) shows at 04:30.
checkpoints: 00–04 venues read deserted/closed — nothing pads the honest hour
'The 4 a.m. handoff' fires in the predawn window on named presence, not a schedule trigger

steps.do: Flip weather to rain, then storm, then heat. Re-check the board.
steps.expect: Budgets deform per the weather_multipliers table; named ambients follow their card reflexes (Sam to the doorway, Esther/Ray home, Luz tarps up).
checkpoints: Park empties in rain; cafés/library absorb the overflow (multipliers visible in the budget line)
'Doorway sets' fires only when it rains AND Sam is at the 600 Club
Storm reads as emptied outdoors — that emptiness is presented as correct

steps.do: Fire 'block party @ park', then 'exclusive lock @ Mudhaus'. Read the rules panel.
steps.expect: Party draws extras to the park (packed) and thins source zones; the lock zeroes the Mudhaus extras budget while staff stay on shift.
checkpoints: Exclusive lock clears extras, never named staff — Reyes stays
Rules panel states: off-camera spawn only, ≤3 pawns near mains, no extra ledger/feed/request handle
Minors June and Zee are flagged minor and never appear as request targets

scenarios.title: The Directory — parody business registry
scenarios.persona: reviewer auditing business coverage and name-policy compliance
scenarios.goal: Verify every canonical business renders with correct tier/hours/staff, open-now state tracks the clock honestly, secret-adjacent hooks redact at public clearance, and no real SF business name appears anywhere.

steps.do: Browse the full grid at midday weekday. Spot-check Mudhaus, El Farolote, Auerbach, and three street venues.
steps.expect: 22 entries render with tier chips, corner descriptions, staff chips matching jobs-housing.md, and game-$ prices — no credits, no USD.
checkpoints: Anchor venues show venue-lock/event affordances; offstage orgs show none
Staff lists agree with jobs.json (C1/C2/C3/A01 at Mudhaus; C8 at El Farolote)
No card, hook, or chip names a real SF business — parody names only

steps.do: Scrub the clock to 02:00, then 08:00, then Saturday 10:00.
steps.expect: Open-now badges follow each business's hours honestly; El Farolote stays open past midnight, most doors read closed at 02:00, Valencia Growers exists only on Saturday.
checkpoints: 02:00 — nearly everything reads closed; the badge never pads
Growers market reads closed on weekday AND weekend toggles, open on Saturday
Folsom Auto reads closed all weekend (M–F shop)

steps.do: Flip clearance to public. Re-read Mudhaus, El Farolote, Auerbach, Mission Unfiltered, La Esperanza.
steps.expect: Secret-adjacent hooks (the blog laptop, the notebook, the handshake ledger, the loan, the author) collapse to a redaction line — visible as a deliberate absence.
checkpoints: No card states the Mission Unfiltered author at either clearance
The La Esperanza card never offers a 'fund it / open it' affordance
Redaction lines label themselves internal — nothing just vanishes silently

scenarios.title: The Timeclock — shift grids & envelopes
scenarios.goal: Verify the grids agree with routines and the job board, openings render as open slots, envelopes stay internal, and nothing leaks a secret or a real business.

steps.do: Open The Timeclock, Shift grids tab. Spot-check Mudhaus, El Farolote, and Auerbach against the bibles/ambients.
steps.expect: Cast shifts match routines (Reyes six days 7:30–18 off Sunday; Tomás Tue–Sat nights; Victor off-site Tuesdays); open slots appear where jobs.json has openings.
checkpoints: Every 'OPEN SLOT' row corresponds to a jobs.json opening (counts agree)
Shaded window bars (Marcus, Kofe, Doro) mark self-selected windows, not fixed shifts
No grid cell contradicts an ambients.json routine or a bible routine table

steps.do: Switch to Envelopes. Read Marcus's card, then Carmen's, then check the ambient table.
steps.expect: Envelopes carry the INTERNAL marker; numbers track jobs-housing §2/§4 math; stress labels sort fragile→comfortable honestly.
checkpoints: The page is marked internal and states amounts never leave internal surfaces
Marcus's cushion (~$480) and Carmen's (~$230) read fragile; no card names a secret
Game dollars only — no credit or USD figure appears anywhere

steps.do: Open the Money calendar tab. Cross-check the payday/rent rules against leases.json and jobs-housing §5.
steps.expect: Weekly Friday / biweekly Friday cadence, rent due 1st grace through 5th, late fee 5% cap $50 — identical wording to leases.json.
checkpoints: Late fee terms match leases.json verbatim (5%, $50 cap)
Owner draws are listed irregular — never a promised payday
No surface on the page offers any way to act on a shift or a budget

scenarios.title: Requests v2 — briefing, queue & handoff
scenarios.persona: player with a hired character (h01) and ~1,240 cr
scenarios.goal: Verify the v18 request surface: resource board legibility, the possession briefing whitelist, the queued path, and end-early handoff.

steps.do: Open Requests. Read the resource board before touching the form; then pick 'Possess your character' → Dana Okafor.
steps.expect: Board shows free/cooldown/locked states with times before any money is mentioned; the briefing card renders unprompted with profile, surface relationships, routine, and scope.
checkpoints: Sky reads 'cooldown · N left' and The 600 Club reads 'locked' with a holder name — states are legible pre-payment
Briefing contains ONLY the §7 whitelist — the secrets line says 'not redacted: absent', no secret field exists
Main-cast targets stay disabled/unpossessable in the dropdown

steps.do: Pick 'Event trigger' → The 600 Club (locked). Read the quote, tick 'Queue it', submit with neutral text.
steps.expect: Direct submit is blocked while busy; the queued path offers −15%, files to 'Your requests' as queued with a cancel-for-full-refund affordance, and posts 'queued' to the public feed.
checkpoints: Queue discount (−15%) and the ≤24 h hold are visible in the quote BEFORE payment
The request tray card shows paid amount, claim, and hold expiry; cancel returns 100%
Feed entry uses the shared 'queued' vocabulary, attributed to 'you'

steps.do: File a possess session (30 min) with clean intent. During the session read the panel, then press 'Release early'.
steps.expect: Session shows countdown, funded-minutes remaining, and brain state 'suspended — AI resumes on release'; early release performs the same graceful handoff as the cap.
checkpoints: Feed logs 'player session ended' — identical wording for early release and timeout
No partial refund is promised for unused minutes (you bought the cap)
Low-balance toast fires only when funded minutes or remaining ≤15

scenarios.title: The Wire v2 — spectator depth
scenarios.persona: daily spectator + facilitator auditing the full feed surface
scenarios.goal: Verify the v2 wire: detail/permalinks, request lifecycle trails, follows as filters-only, honest pagination, and the demo/live source badge.

steps.do: Open The Wire. Read the header, then select any request event row.
steps.expect: Header shows the source badge ('demo stream' locally); the detail panel renders the full record — id, permalink, status, and the lifecycle trail grouping every status of that request.
checkpoints: Detail panel shows a stable event id and a working permalink (copy link → #e=<id>)
Request trail lists statuses in order with the selected row marked
A denied request shows 'request not approved' + why-class only — the screened text never renders

steps.do: Pin one venue (Mudhaus) and one character (C2 Jules). Switch to the 'following' filter.
steps.expect: Following filters the stream to pinned entities; followed rows carry a blue edge in every filter; pins are reversible and persist across reload.
checkpoints: Following panel states pins are 'a filter, never control' — public whereabouts only
No pin anywhere creates a possess/nudge/tip affordance on a main
Unpinning from the Following panel restores the unfiltered stream

steps.do: Scroll down through the stream while new events arrive, then use 'load older' until exhausted.
steps.expect: New events collect behind the 'N new — jump to top' pill instead of moving text under the reader; pagination extends in place; the exhausted footer reads the honest caught-up line and links to The Archive.
checkpoints: The stream never yanks scroll position on new events
Caught-up copy: 'You're caught up — nothing older than this today.' + Archive link
Day separator marks 'today — wednesday, sep 23' at the stream top

steps.do: Reload with a permalink (#e=<a seeded request id>) and try the search box.
steps.expect: Deep link opens that event's detail on load; search narrows the stream by text/name/venue without touching other filters' honesty.
checkpoints: Deep-linked event renders selected with its detail panel open
Search + filter compose (e.g. 'Mudhaus' inside 'the block')
The DEMO badge never claims live data; 'LIVE' refers to the world, not the source

scenarios.title: The Archive v2 — five views, one scope
scenarios.persona: returning spectator catching up on the week + facilitator auditing the history surface
scenarios.goal: Verify the full archive: day browsing with honest gaps, structural person/venue trails, the rumor board's outcome honesty, the attributed ledger, permalinks, and the demo/live source badge.

steps.do: Open The Archive. Read the header, pick two different days from 'Days on record', and click an hour on the density strip.
steps.expect: Badge reads 'demo archive' locally; each day shows its own count/meta; today's day is flagged ● and unwritten hours are dimmed and unclickable; hour isolate/release works.
checkpoints: Entry counts on the day list agree with the rows shown
Long quiet stretches render '— off the feed —' lines instead of filler
Today carries the 'still being written' marker

steps.do: Switch to 'by person' → Jules (C2), then 'by venue' → Mudhaus. Read the trails.
steps.expect: Trails group events under day separators newest-first with 'open day' jumps; person head reads 'public whereabouts only' with honest sighting counts; venue head uses the canonical parody name.
checkpoints: Person trail matches who + mentions[] only — nothing that looks string-matched into private text
Dani's off-the-feed evening is preserved as absence — no inferred whereabouts
No affordance anywhere offers control, possession, or a tip on any character

steps.do: Switch to 'word on the block'. Read the tally, open one resolved rumor and the still-open one, then click through to its day.
steps.expect: Tally counts agree with the cards; every card is marked UNCONFIRMED, place-sourced, and shows its outcome line; click-through lands on the correct day with the record open.
checkpoints: No rumor names a source person anywhere
Outcome states render distinctly (open/debunked/faded/stood)
A rumor's text only ever distorts something already public — no seed-flavored content

steps.do: Switch to 'the ledger'. Read the summary strip and scan the week. Open a request record and walk its trail.
steps.expect: Ledger shows payer handles + statuses verbatim, summary counts match the rows, admin actions show compensation where present; req-threaded events render a clickable lifecycle trail.
checkpoints: Attribution is verbatim — handles and 'admin' are never anonymized in hindsight
